sloka: उत्थास्यति च मेदिन्याः कृपणः पाम्सुगुण्ठितः ।विनिःस्वसन् प्रस्रवणात्क रेणूनामि वर्ष्भः ॥२-४२-१७॥
transliteration: utthāsyati ca medinyāḥ kṛpaṇaḥ pāmsuguṇṭhitaḥ ।viniḥsvasan prasravaṇātka reṇūnāmi varṣbhaḥ ॥2-42-17॥

translations.english: That unfortunate Rama, having been covered with dust, will get up from the ground sighing like a bull elephant rising from mount Prasravana.
